title: The Telangana Irrigation (Construction and Maintenance of Water Courses) Act, 1965.
full_text: The Telangana Irrigation (Construction and Maintenance of Water Courses) Act, 1965. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 196512 Act Number: 12 Enactment Date: 1965-04-23 Act Year: 1965 Short Title: The Telangana Irrigation (Construction and Maintenance of Water Courses) Act, 1965. Long Title: An Act to provide for the Construction and Maintenance of Water Courses in the Ayacut of Irrigation Works and for matters connected therewith. Department: Department of Irrigation and Command Area Development Enforcement Date: 01-05-1965 Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Obligation of ayacutdars to construct water courses. Section 4. Power of Irrigation Officer to construct water-course suo motu or on application. Section 5. Enquiry into objections and publication. Section 6. Acquisition of land. Section 6-A. Acquisition of land with the consent of the beneficiaries. Section 7. The cost of construction of watercourse. Section 8. Construction of water-course. Section 9. Recovery of the cost of construction of water-course when it is carried out by the Irrigation Officer. Section 10. Discontinuance from the construction of water-courses. Section 11. Obligation of owners of lands which receive or discharge water through water-course. Section 12. Right to enforce the obligation under section 11. Section 13. Protection of action taken under the Act. Section 14. Act to override other laws, contracts, etc. Section 15. Power to make rules. Section 16. Repeal.
